verses: Rehman ney
Quran sikhaya
Ussi ney insan ko peda kiya
Aur ussay bolna sikhaya
Aftab aur mahtab (muqarrara) hisab say hain
Aur sitaray aur darakht dono sajdah kertay hain
Ussi ney aasman ko buland kiya aur ussi ney tarazoo rakhi
Takay tum tolney mein tajawuz na kero
Insaf kay sath wazan ko theek rakho aur tol mein kum na do
Aur ussi ney makhlooq kay liye zamin bicha di
Jiss mein meway hain aur khoshay walay khajoor kay darakht hain
Aur bhuss wala anaj hai. Aur khushboodar phool hain
Pus (aey insano aur jinno!) tum apney perwerdigar ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Uss insan ko bajney wali mitti say peda kiya jo theekri ki tarah thi
Aur jinnat ko aag kay sholay say peda kiya
Pus tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Woh rab hai dono mashriqon aur dono maghribon ka
To (aey jinno insano!) tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Uss ney do darya jari ker diye jo aik doosray say mill jatay hain
Unn dono mein aik aarr hai kay uss say barh nahi saktay
Pus apney perwerdigar ki kaun kaun si nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Unn dono mein say moti aur mongey baraamad hotay hain
Phir tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Aur Allah hi ki (milkiyat mein) hain woh jahaaz jo samandaron mein pahar ki tarah buland (chal phir rahey) hain
Pus (aey insano aur jinno!) tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Zamin per jo hain sab fana honey walay hain
Sirf teray rab ki zaat jo azmat aur izzat wali hai baqi reh jaye gi
Phir apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Sab aasman o zamin walay ussi say mangtay hain. Her roz woh aik shaan mein hai
Phir tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
(jinno aur insano kay giroho!) unqareeb hum tumhari taraf poori tarah mutawajha ho jayen gay
Phir tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhut?
Aey giroh jinnat o insan! agar tum mein aasmano aur zamin kay kinaron say bahir nikal janey ki taqat hai to nikal bhago! baghair ghalba aur taqat kay tum nahi nikal saktay
Phir tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Tum per aag kay sholay aur dhuwan chora jaye ga phir tum muqabla na ker sako gay
Phir apney rab ki nematon mein say kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Pus jab kay aasman phat ker surkh ho jaye jaisay kay surkh chamra
Pus tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Uss din kissi insan kissi jin say uss kay gunahon ki pursish na ki jaye gi
Pus tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Gunah gaar sirf huliye hi say pehchan liye jayen gay aur unn ki peshaniyon kay baal aur qadam pakar liye jayen gay
Pus tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Yeh hai woh jahannum jissay mujrim jhoota jantay thay
Uss kay aur kholtay huye garum pani kay darmiyan chakkar khayen gay
Pus tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Aur uss shakhs kay liye jo apney rab kay samney khara honey say dara do jannaten hain
Pus tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
(dono jannaten) boht si tehniyon aur shakhon wali hain
Pus tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Unn dono (jannaton) mein do behtay huye chashmay hain
Pus tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Unn dono jannaton mein her qasam kay mewon ki do qasmen hogi
Phir tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Jannati aisay farshon per takiya lagaye huye hun gay jin kay astar dabeez resham kay hun gay, aur unn dono jannaton kay meway bilkul qareeb hun gay
Pus tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
O haan (sharmeeli) neechi nigah wali hooren hain jinhen unn say pehlay kissi jin jinn-o-ins ney hath nahi lagaya
Pus apney paalney walay ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Woh hooren misil yaqoot aur mongey kay hun gi
Pus tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Ehsan ka badla ehsan kay siwa kiya hai
Pus tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Aur unn kay siwa do jannaten aur hain
Pus tum apney perwerish kerney walay ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Jo dono gehri sabz siyahi maeel hain
Batao abb apney perwerdigar ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Unn mein do (josh say) ubalney walay chashmay hain
Phir tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Unn dono mein meway aur khajoor aur anaar hun gay
Kiya abb bhi rab ki kissi nemat ki takzeeb tum kero gay?
Unn mein nek seerat khoobsurat aurten hain
Pus tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
(gori rangat ki) hooren jannati khemon mein rehney waliyan hain
Pus (aey insano aur jinno!) tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Unn ko hath nahi lagaya kissi insan ya jin ney uss say qabal
Pus apney perwerdigar ki kaun kaun si nemat kay sath tum takzeeb kertay ho?
Sabz masnadon aur umdah farshon per takiya lagaye huye hun gay
Pus (aey jinno aur insano!) tum apney rab ki kiss kiss nemat ko jhutlao gay?
Teray perwerdigar ka naam ba-barkat hai jo izzat o jalal wala hai
